definitions.explanation: Information communicated to someone; a message informing about something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{知|し}らせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知|し}らせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A notice about the meeting schedule change came.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知|し}らせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for word from him.

notes:
{知|し}らせ is the noun form derived from the verb ⟦{知|し}らせる→知らせる：01208_shiraseru⟧ (to inform). It means a piece of news, a notice, or a notification that someone conveys.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{知|し}らせ / ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{知|し}らせ: good news
- ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧{知|し}らせ: sad news
- {知|し}らせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: notice arrives
- {知|し}らせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive notice
- {知|し}らせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: word comes

お{知|し}らせ:
The polite form ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧{知|し}らせ is extremely common in public announcements, official notices, websites, and formal communication. It is one of the most frequently seen polite-prefix nouns in Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知|し}らせ: news or notification (from a specific source)
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧: news (general, from media)
- ⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: formal notification (official, written)
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: contact, communication (broader, includes updates)
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report (formal, detailed)
